text:
We're hiring a backend engineer (remote, EU time zones)

The team is growing, and we need someone to help build the fast, reliable systems our customers use every day.

You'd write our services in Go, with Postgres as the main datastore. The team is small and works closely together, and we care about clean code, careful reviews, and shipping often.

The salary band is €70,000 to €95,000, depending on experience. The role is fully remote as long as you're in an EU time zone. You'd own your work, and it goes to production where customers rely on it.

The hiring process has 3 interview rounds:
1. An intro call to get to know each other and talk about the role
2. A technical conversation about how you design and build backend systems
3. A final meeting with the team, so you can see how we work together

You'll fit in well if you've built and run production services, like working on hard data problems, and enjoy working with people who care about their craft.

If you're interested, apply through the link or send me a DM. Sharing this with someone in your network helps a lot too.
